The line graph shows that the domestic tourist flow of this provincial-level administrative region is relatively high around winter, especially highest in December, about 1.6 million person-times, and also relatively high in January and November; while it is relatively low around June and September, overall presenting the characteristic of being relatively low from summer to early autumn and clearly increasing in winter. <image1>

Which provincial-level administrative region of our country is this provincial-level administrative region most likely to be?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：该图横轴为1—12月，纵轴为游客流量，曲线显示冬季尤其12月、1月游客量高，夏季至初秋相对偏低。再推理：题干说明这是我国某省级行政区的国内游客流量变化，若一个省区旅游高峰出现在冬季而不是暑期，最符合热带避寒旅游地特征。我国省级行政区中最典型的是海南，所以答案为海南。
